title: Zak Designs Disney Pixar Cars Sage 16oz Leak-Proof Straw Kids Water Bottle | BPA Free, Durable Plastic, Cupholder Friendly, Dishwasher Safe, Easy to Clean, Lid Lock, Handle, For School, Home, Travel
features: SIZE & MATERIAL: This zak! water bottle has a 16-ounce capacity, measuring 4.33 by 2.78 inches wide and 7 inches tall. It's made of durable and break-resistant plastic, and recommended for children age 3 and up.
EASY TO CLEAN: This travel water bottles is top rack dishwasher safe, and with the removable straw and silicone spout, the lid can be disassembled for thorough cleaning.

HYGIENIC SPOUT COVER: Keep the spout clean in the house or while you're traveling—the spout cover protects contact surfaces and has a flip-up lock to keep it closed, preventing leaks and spills. When it's time to drink, the action lid allows one-handed operation, and the spout easily pops up at the push of a button.

FEATURES: The leak-proof water bottle has a comfortable silicone spout that is easy for kids to drink from and a screw-on lid that prevents splashes and mess. It fits in most car cup holders for convenient travel.
LIFESTYLE: Staying hydrated is an important part of being healthy! With fun art featuring Cars characters, zak! designs' innovative water bottles help make it easy for grown-ups and fun for kids!
